# Git for Strategy

> A file contract for strategic work: scouts, decisions with rulings in the decider's own words, specs, commissions, retros, and seeds, kept in plain markdown inside a repository. Part of Dojo Genesis.

## What this is

- The contract: SPEC.md — seven invariants, the artifact types with their folders, names, headers, required sections, and status values, the lifecycle, pipeline health, the pre-commission gate, and conformance levels.
- The reference implementation: scripts/gfs.py (Python 3.9+, standard library only) — init, new, validate, status, gate, seeds.
- A Claude Code plugin: commands /scout, /decide, /spec, /commission, /retro, /status, /seed, /close, and a session-start status note.
- Seeds: reusable patterns from real work, in seeds/.
- It is not a runtime, a memory system, or a coordination protocol, and it ships no practice skills; those live in the Dojo Genesis library.

## Install

- Claude Code: clone the repository, then `claude --plugin-dir <path>`.
- Start a workspace: `python3 scripts/gfs.py init` (or `--root strategy`), then add `@STRATEGY.md` to CLAUDE.md.
- Any other agent: point AGENTS.md or the tool's rules file at STRATEGY.md and use scripts/gfs.py.

## How to use with LLMs

- Read STRATEGY.md in the workspace first.
- Create artifacts with `gfs.py new <type> "<title>"`; run `gfs.py validate` before calling the work done.
- The person makes the calls. Record rulings in their own words; leave Status at Proposed until they rule.
- No number without a source; otherwise write "not measured."
